Generate linkage bubble plot by sector category

generate_prs_plot.Rd

Scatter plot of ITBL (Indeks Daya Penyebaran) against ITFL (Indeks Derajat Kepekaan), with bubble size showing combined linkage strength and colour showing sector category. Quadrant reference lines are drawn at 1.

Usage

generate_prs_plot(linkages_table, show_labels = TRUE, base_size = 12)

Arguments

linkages_table

A tibble produced by [create_linkages_table()].

show_labels

Logical. If `TRUE`, sector IDs are displayed.

base_size

Numeric. Base font size for ggplot.

Value

A `ggplot` object.

Details

Use [generate_quadrant_plot()] for the companion view coloured by BPS quadrant instead of category.
